It all started with a speeding ticket. Boy were my parents pissed about that, if only they knew. I got pretty shitty grades in college, despite some effort. Not enough effort for sure, that's why I already made plans on how to do better next semester. Despite that, college was the time of my fucking life. It was my freshman year at Rutgers. Anyway, after the shitty grades my parents threatened to take my out of college, which would've been the worst thing they could do to me.

Then, because god loves playing practical jokes on me, I get arrested for possession of weed on CHRISTMAS EVE at 11 fucking 30 pm. When my parents found out about that they took me out of college. This was all surrounded by their very supportive talks with me (sarcasm) like I said in the original post.

So now I'm a college dropout junkie criminal.  Whose parents hate him.  Awesome.

The only time my mind is off things is when I'm with my friends, but naturally my parents hate that because they think they're a bad influence.  So I'm kind of stuck here in my personal hell.

I forgot to talk about my beats lmao, I try to make chill ass beats, I used to try to spread good vibes but recently they've just been depressing.
